publisher: City of Horace (hosted on ArcGIS Online)
filter: LAYER <> '' AND Full_Name IS NOT NULL
notes: City of Horace official zoning map service. Zoning_Districts layer; zone code in LAYER (e.g. Z SR), name in Full_Name. Features are parcel-level polygons carrying zoning; parcels without a zone code are excluded by the filter. Owner names in Name. Extra-territorial boundaries are a separate layer (FeatureServer/1), not included.
